project_type: pnpm monorepo: NestJS 10 + Prisma 5.18 (Postgres) API in apps/api, Next 14 (app router, client components for admin) web in apps/web, pure TS shared package in packages/shared
build_system: pnpm 9.12 workspaces. packages/shared builds with tsc to dist (CommonJS). The API resolves @belzo/shared from packages/shared/dist at typecheck/runtime (so `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build` MUST run before `pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck`), while API jest and web jest/tsconfig map @belzo/shared to packages/shared/src/index.ts. Web uses transpilePackages ['@belzo/shared'] and tsconfig paths to the shared ESM source. Prisma client must be regenerated after schema changes (`pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate`).
test_framework: jest 29 + ts-jest 29 everywhere; fast-check 3.20.0 in shared and api. shared: src/**/*.test.ts; api: src/**/*.spec.ts; web: src/**/*.test.ts (node env, '@/' -> apps/web/src).
build_command: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build ; pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate ; pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck ; pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck ; pnpm --filter @belzo/web build
test_command: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test ; pnpm --filter @belzo/api test ; pnpm --filter @belzo/web test
verification_instructions: Run from c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo, PowerShell, ONE command per call, in this order: 1) pnpm install  2) pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build  3) pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test  4) pnpm --filter @belzo/shared lint  5) pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate  6) pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck  7) pnpm --filter @belzo/api test  8) pnpm --filter @belzo/api lint  9) pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck  10) pnpm --filter @belzo/web test  11) pnpm --filter @belzo/web lint  12) pnpm --filter @belzo/web build (then compare First Load JS of / and /product/[slug] with .agents/tasks/bulk-excel-template/build-baseline.txt; delta must be < 1 kB). Each FEAT runs the subset listed in its own `verification`. Record the outcome (pass/fail, counts) in the FEAT's `findings`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client (node_modules/.prisma, not checked in) from `pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate`. pnpm-lock.yaml changes when exceljs is added (`pnpm --filter @belzo/web add exceljs@4.4.0 --save-exact`) and IS committed. packages/shared/dist and apps/web/.next are build output, never committed.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell; no worktree: work directly in c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo on branch master. Use absolute paths. Commit locally only, NEVER push, never deploy, never run migrations against production. The repo is only PARTIALLY tracked by git (e.g. apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma, apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/catalogue.module.ts and packages/shared/src/money.ts are untracked and already modified by earlier work): stage ONLY (a) tracked files you changed and (b) brand-new files this task created; never `git add` a file that was untracked before this task, never `git add .`/`-A`, never stage anything under .agents/. `prisma generate` can fail with EPERM on Windows when a running API dev server locks query_engine-windows.dll.node: retry once, then send_message severity 'warning' asking the user to stop the API dev server; do not kill processes you did not start. `next build` rewrites apps/web/.next: if a `next dev` is running on :3000 (check with `Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`), ask before building. Applying the migration (`pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:migrate`) is optional and only against a LOCAL Postgres; if DATABASE_URL is not a localhost URL or the DB is unreachable, skip it and say so (do not print the URL or its credentials). scripts/deploy.ps1 does not run migrations, so the final report must say the migration has to be applied on deploy.
contribution_requirements: Money is integer paise end to end; rupee<->paise only at the sheet boundary. Pin new deps to exact versions (exceljs 4.4.0 --save-exact, apps/web only). Do NOT change packages/shared/src/pricing.ts, checkout, invoices, VariantService.remove, the media picker or product-editor behaviour beyond what design.md states. costPrice is ADMIN-ONLY (never in a storefront/public DTO). Every new route sits on AdminCatalogueController (class-level @Roles('catalogue_manager')). bulk-sheet.ts must have NO module-scope side effects (lazy alias Map) so it tree-shakes out of storefront bundles. Commit style from git log: conventional-ish 'feat(scope): ...', 'fix(scope): ...'.
key_patterns: Zod DTOs via createZodDto (apps/api/src/modules/identity/zod-dto) declared at the top of admin-catalogue.controller.ts. Services are @Injectable with PrismaService; interactive transactions via this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => ...). Logger pattern: private readonly logger = new Logger('X'). API specs build hand-written in-memory fake Prisma objects (see product.service.spec.ts build(), variant.service.spec.ts build()) cast `as unknown as PrismaService`. ProductService.bulkUpsert has the category resolver (normKey/resolveCategory) to be extracted as category-match.ts. Web admin pages are 'use client' and call adminFetch<T>(path, { method, body }) / adminUpload(file, 'products') from apps/web/src/lib/admin-api.ts; ApiClientError.payload.statusCode carries HTTP status (401 => 'Your admin session has expired. Please log in again and retry.'). Admin CSS classes: admin-card, admin-card__head, admin-table, admin-status admin-status--ok/--bad/--warn, admin-muted, admin-inline-btn, btn, prod-form__msg, wiz__drop*. Product-wizard single-variant products store Size and Color on BOTH product attributesJson and variant attributesJson (product-wizard.tsx productAttributes + per-variant attrs).
relevant_files: apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/product.service.ts (uniqueSlug, findOrCreateBrandByName, bulkUpsert, exportRows/toExportRows to remove, detail, list)
apps/web/src/lib/csv.ts, csv.test.ts, product-csv.ts (to delete), variant-edit.ts, variant-edit.test.ts, admin-api.ts, api-client.ts
apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/bulk/page.tsx, page.tsx, export-button.tsx (to delete), product-editor.tsx, variant-slabs.tsx, product-wizard.tsx (read-only reference)
directory_structure: apps/api/src/modules/catalogue = catalogue domain (controllers, services, specs); apps/api/prisma = schema + migrations; packages/shared/src = pure shared logic + *.test.ts; apps/web/src/lib = pure client helpers + *.test.ts; apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue = admin catalogue UI (page.tsx list, bulk/page.tsx bulk upload, product-editor.tsx, variant-slabs.tsx, product-wizard.tsx); .agents/tasks/bulk-excel-template = design, review, plan and FEAT artifacts (never committed).
